_about: Catalogue of videos-raw/ — one entry per clip: subject, tags, quality 1-3 (3 = site-worthy), duration, dims (rotation-corrected), shot date, loopable (works as a silent 3-8s web loop), dupe notes. Maintained by Claude via scripts/video-sheets.py (contact sheets, so nobody has to watch video to know what we have). Web conversion: scripts/video-web.sh. Check this file before any video work — same rule as the photo catalogue.
